dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: (These notes are full of scribbled writings. There are many words written in between the lines, too. Untalented writers tend to pad out their writing like this.)

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...This morning I had a nosebleed. The concentration of elements in the air is very dense... But there's something else that's disturbing..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "The locals call it Tatarigami, but it is actually a fragment of some sort of god... I helped Mr. Kaji to identify several stone lanterns, which are supposed to neutralize the Tatarigami in the air..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...But the focus of my research is on these mechanisms... If I can make some progress here, perhaps I can persuade the Akademiya to open up the subject of Monsterology..."
